about.intro_en: I am a second-year Digital Media and Culture student at King’s College London, interested in how complex social and cultural ideas can be communicated clearly across audiences. My research spans AI-generated content, wearable technology and interface design. This year I also mentor first-year students as a Peer Mentor. In 2026, I interned at People’s Daily, planning an archaeological live broadcast and a documentary series on Chinese food culture, and researching a Sino-foreign co-production. With nearly ten years of self-taught programming and fluency in AI tools, I turn ideas into thoughtful, accessible media.
about.intro_zh: 我是伦敦国王学院数字媒体与文化专业大二学生，关注如何向不同受众清晰传达复杂的社会与文化议题。我的研究涵盖 AIGC、可穿戴技术与界面设计。今年我还担任朋辈导师，帮助大一新生适应大学生活。2026 年，我在人民日报实习，参与策划考古直播与中华美食纪录片，并为中外合拍项目做调研。凭借近十年的自学编程经验和对 AI 工具的熟练运用，我能把想法落地为有深度、易理解的媒体作品。

design.title_zh: 班会专业简介：新闻传播学
design.detail_zh: 以张雪峰“报考新闻学”言论风波为引，谈新闻制造与新闻理想：从《新闻女王》《新闻编辑室》《白日之下》等影视，到“文科作为服务业到底服务了谁”。
design.detail_en: Opening with a viral debate over studying journalism (Mandarin): news-making vs journalistic ideals through films from The Newsreader to Spotlight — asking whom the humanities serve.
design.intro_zh: 这是高中时期一次班会上的专业介绍讲演，主题是新闻传播学。讲演以张雪峰“劝退”新闻学考生的言论风波开场，讨论“新闻已死”论调背后的真相：新闻行业或许式微，但“制造新闻”从未停止。从《新闻女王》到《聚焦》《白日之下》，讲演用影视案例拆解新闻生产中的取舍与操纵，进而追问——如果文科都是服务业，它到底服务了谁？结尾落在《聚焦》的那句 Break the Story, Break the Silence，以及“十年之后还会不会有记者”的提问。
design.intro_en: A class-meeting talk introducing journalism studies (Mandarin). Opening with a viral debate over whether to study journalism, it contrasts the decline of the news industry with the boom of news-making — through films from The Newsreader to Spotlight — and asks whom the humanities truly serve.

design.detail_zh: 41 页课堂讲演：从托尔斯泰的生平与出走之死讲起，重述聂赫留朵夫与玛丝洛娃的“复活”，并以福柯、康德与列宁对照托尔斯泰主义的道德自我完善与不以暴力抗恶。
design.detail_en: A 41-slide literature-class talk (Mandarin): Tolstoy's life and flight, the twin resurrections of Nekhlyudov and Maslova, read through Foucault, Kant and Lenin.
design.intro_zh: 语文课堂上的托尔斯泰专题讲演，共 41 页。从托尔斯泰的贵族出身、出走与去世讲起，重述《复活》中聂赫留朵夫与玛丝洛娃两条“复活”的轨迹，并引入三重视角：福柯的规训与惩罚、康德的道德哲学、列宁的革命镜说，最终落到托尔斯泰主义的核心——道德的自我完善与不以暴力抗恶。
design.intro_en: A 41-slide literature-class talk on Tolstoy's Resurrection (Mandarin): Tolstoy's life and flight, the twin resurrections of Nekhlyudov and Maslova, read through Foucault, Kant and Lenin toward Tolstoyan moral self-perfection and non-resistance.

design.detail_zh: 为校戏剧社设计的电影培训：杨德昌生平、“电影让人生延长三倍”，NJ 一家的剧情与经典台词，结尾附二十余部延伸片单。
design.detail_en: A film-training session for the school drama club (Mandarin): Edward Yang's life, the NJ family's story and its oft-quoted lines, closing with a 20-plus-film watchlist.
design.intro_zh: 为校戏剧社做的一次电影培训，以杨德昌的《一一》为教材。从导演生平讲到“电影发明以后，人类的寿命延长了三倍”，细读 NJ 一家人的故事与那些被反复引用的台词，最后附上一份二十余部的延伸片单，供社员课后观看。
design.intro_en: A film-training session for the school drama club built around Edward Yang's Yi Yi (Mandarin): the director's life, the NJ family's story and its oft-quoted lines, closing with a 20-plus-film watchlist.

design.title_zh: 政治课堂讲演：中国房地产改革40年
design.title_en: 40 Years of Housing Reform in China (Mandarin)
design.detail_zh: 38 页课堂讲演：以自家“平房—套二—套三—买房—新房”五段居住史为线，串起 1979–2022 年住房商品化、产业化与回归居住属性的三阶段，兼引黄奇帆、兰小欢与吴晓波。
design.detail_en: A 38-slide classroom talk (Mandarin): five chapters of one family's housing history — from bungalows to mortgaged flats — tracing three stages of reform from 1979 to 2022.
design.intro_zh: 2022 年 9 月的政治课堂讲演，用 38 页梳理中国房地产改革 40 年。讲演以自家五段居住史（平房、套二、套三、买房、新房）为线索，串起三个阶段：1979–1996 年商品化开启、1997–2014 年产业化拉动增长、2015 年之后回归居住属性。理论上兼引黄奇帆的市场分析、兰小欢《置身事内》的政府视角与吴晓波的商业史叙述，收束于“房住不炒”与“那是一个好的时代”。
design.intro_en: A September 2022 politics-class talk in 38 slides (Mandarin): five chapters of one family's housing history frame three stages of reform — commercialization (1979–1996), industrialization (1997–2014), and the return to housing-as-shelter — with Huang Qifan, Lan Xiaohuan and Wu Xiaobo.
